exposure: Combinations of these treatments (DS, CN, SN, DN, DSN)
outcome: mRNA expression profiles of alveolar epithelia-associated cytokines and inflammatory mediators
cohort: Pregnant New Zealand White rabbits at 25-day gestation and their very preterm newborn offspring delivered via cesarean at 26-day gestation.
finding: Combined regimens of perinatal medications, particularly Dexamethasone, Surfactant, and Nitric Oxide (DSN), significantly improved survival length and various lung health parameters in very preterm rabbits.
